item.title: From MLIPs to Microstructure: A High-Throughput Computational Framework to Design Spinodal Alloys in High-Dimensional Composition Spaces via Analytic Derivatives of CALPHAD Model Predictions
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Courtney Kunselman, Doguhan Sariturk, Siya Zhu, Vahid Attari, Raymundo Arroyave
arXiv:2607.20077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying regions of design space subject to spinodal decomposition is a critical component of alloy design in high-dimensional composition spaces. In cases where designers are seeking to exploit spinodal microstructures to tailor alloy properties, prediction of microstructure evolution and morphology is also needed. In this work, we present a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP)-trained, CALPHAD-based, open-source workflow for high-throughput microstructure stability analysis and visualization. In this workflow, coherent strain contributions are captured via high-throughput MLIP elastic constant calculations. item.title: PN-QNN: Harnessing Physical Noise as a Native Regularizer in Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Farah Elnakhal, Alberto Marchisio, Nouhaila Innan, Gabriel Falcao, Muhammad Shafique
arXiv:2607.20045v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical noise in near-term quantum hardware is usually treated as a nuisance to suppress. We ask whether it can instead act as a hardware-native regularizer for photonic hybrid quantum-classical neural networks (PHQCNNs), analogous to noise-injection regularization in classical deep learning. Using Quandela's Perceval simulator and the MerLin framework, we build PHQCNNs for Iris, Digits, and MNIST and inject Perceval's seven-parameter physical noise model directly into training. A genetic algorithm searches the six continuous noise dimensions and 1 boolean parameter to find, per dataset, the configuration maximizing validation accuracy, compared against a noiseless baseline across five seeds. arXiv:2507.03853v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce OrbitAll, a geometry- and physics-informed deep learning framework that encodes any molecular system with arbitrary charges, spins, and environmental effects using electronic structure information. OrbitAll demonstrates superior performance and generalization in predicting charged, open-shell, and solvated molecules, and robustly extrapolates to molecules significantly larger than the training data. item.title: Neural networks unlock larger quantum simulations with lower computational costs
item.description:
📚 Physics News
In recent years, research using artificial intelligence to predict material properties has advanced rapidly. Neural network quantum Monte Carlo methods have attracted attention as highly accurate simulation techniques. However, their extremely high computational cost has limited their application to small molecular systems. This study introduces a new computational method that overcomes this limitation.

arXiv:2607.20036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a small fraction of antiferromagnetic bonds qualitatively alters the long-wavelength dynamics of two-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnets. Magnetic materials cooled towards absolute zero typically develop a long-range ordered state. In frustrated magnets, however, competing interactions cannot be simultaneously satisfied, leading to a macroscopically degenerate ground state. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jingruo Peng, Shuze Zhu
该文提出一种变分学习框架，旨在模拟人类从极少数观测中泛化物理结果的“物理直觉”。作者用仅由两三个样例训练的小型神经网络刻画由观测张成的解流形，从而在经典和量子变分问题中推广到未见情形，包括强关联分子体系。其理论解释是：沿解流形，Euler–Lagrange算子必须对观测参数保持驻定；流形复杂度决定临界网络容量，低于该容量时泛化会失效。

👤 Ji-Hoon Heo, Aleksandra Joanna Wisniewska, Seo-Hyun Lee, Seong-Whan Lee
该研究面向侵入式神经记录中因电极布局、解剖结构和神经信号模式差异导致的跨被试泛化难题，提出跨被试语义解码框架。方法使用自然语言理解任务中的皮层脑电数据，通过共享响应模型将多名被试对语音感知的神经响应对齐到共享潜空间，再训练解码器从对齐后的神经表征预测上下文语义嵌入。对留出被试，仅估计其到预定义共享空间的投影并直接使用预训练解码器；实验显示该框架优于基线方法，并减小从源被试到留出被试测试的性能下降。

item.title: 将机器遗忘视为分布恢复：受控反事实研究、经验证的选择性筛查与无Oracle认证的局限
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sen Yang, Yuen-Hei Yeung
该研究批判了机器遗忘中常用的“与重训练oracle在训练探针上匹配”的评价标准，指出该标准可能偏好仍保留未见遗忘知识的方法。作者在受控nonce事实测试床和匹配重训练参考下，将遗忘重新表述为恢复到匹配参考分布，并在45个模型—随机种子单元、五类开放架构上审计无oracle筛查和证书式判据。结果显示，绝对保留/往返证书并不可靠；基于基模型锚定的留出筛查作为选择性必要测试表现较强，但只能提供有测得灵敏度的必要条件，不能作为充分认证。

item.title: 重尾网络上的强制凝聚与反凝聚
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 T. Ashwin Bhattathiripad, Vipin P. Veetil
该研究分析固定重尾网络上的驱动选择机制：每一步根据当前质量分布用幂归一化规则确定新注入方向，再由原始混合矩阵传播既有存量与新增质量。反馈指数θ控制偏置，正值偏向大坐标，负值偏向小坐标；在去除总质量确定性增长后，作者给出注入分布收敛到单纯形上非线性Perron–Frobenius型不动点的显式混合—驱动条件。Hilbert射影度量揭示了稳定机制，并区分了重尾网络中响应/度倾斜、异常逆参与比标度和真正少数节点局域化三类效应。
